about: The agent, delegate and agent_status tools. {types} is the platform's agent-type list (catalog.describe()); the agent description is agentDescription, then "\n\n" + the case's catalogue when it has one. Parameters compare as parsed JSON; descriptions character by character. Descriptions never carry load: loads change only the load lines.
agentDescription: Spawn a subagent to work a self-contained task (e.g. 'find every usage of X and report the call sites'). It works autonomously in a bounded loop and returns a final report. Prefer this over doing long exploration yourself when the task is well-scoped. Pick agent_type for a specialist — {types}. Omit it for the general worker. Several agent calls in one turn run at the same time. Set run_in_background to true to launch it in the background and keep working: check on it with agent_status (you're also told automatically when one finishes) and stop one with agent_stop. To fan out many independent tasks in one go, use `delegate`.

prompt.description: The complete task for the subagent. It cannot ask you questions and cannot see this conversation — everything it needs goes here.

server.description: Where this task runs: an id from the subagent servers listed in the agent tool, or "primary" for this chat's own model. Leave it out to let Vision pick the least busy. A chosen server that is busy is waited for up to 2 minutes; after that, or if it can't take the task, another server runs it and the report says so.

run_in_background.description: Start it in the background and return at once (default false: wait for its report)

step.description: Which step of your plan (todo_write) this subagent works: its number in the plan (1 = the first) or its text. Shown on that step.

sensitive.description: Set true when the task needs sensitive data (personal data, credentials, client details). It then runs only on a private server.

delegateDescription: Run several independent subtasks at the same time, each by its own subagent, and get all their reports back together. Use it to fan work out — investigate three modules, review four files, implement three unrelated changes — instead of doing them one after another. Subtasks cannot talk to each other or see this conversation, so each prompt must be complete; make sure they don't edit the same files. Give each an agent_type: {types}. Without a server, tasks spread across the subagent servers by load; give a task `server` (an id listed in the agent tool) to choose where it runs.

description.description: A short name for the subtask

server.description: Where this task runs: an id from the subagent servers listed in the agent tool, or "primary" for this chat's own model. Leave it out to let Vision pick the least busy. A chosen server that is busy is waited for up to 2 minutes; after that, or if it can't take the task, another server runs it and the report says so. (This task only.)

step.description: Which step of your plan (todo_write) this subagent works: its number in the plan (1 = the first) or its text. Shown on that step.

sensitive.description: Set true when the task needs sensitive data (personal data, credentials, client details). It then runs only on a private server. (This task only.)

tasks.description: The subtasks to run in parallel

max_parallel.description: At most this many at once (default 6)

server.description: Where this task runs: an id from the subagent servers listed in the agent tool, or "primary" for this chat's own model. Leave it out to let Vision pick the least busy. A chosen server that is busy is waited for up to 2 minutes; after that, or if it can't take the task, another server runs it and the report says so. (Every task without its own.)

sensitive.description: Set true when the task needs sensitive data (personal data, credentials, client details). It then runs only on a private server. (Every task.)

agentStatusDescription: Check on background subagents started with agent(run_in_background: true). Without an id, lists them all and how busy each subagent server is. With an id, returns that agent's full report when it has finished; pass wait_seconds to wait for it (up to 600) instead of polling.

cases.name: a mixed pool
cases.catalogue:
Subagent servers — set `server` to one of these ids to choose where a task runs, or leave it out and Vision picks the least busy:
- dgx-spark: OpenAI-compatible server · qwen3-coder-30b · 256K context · private · local · standard · images · 2 at a time
- bedrock: Amazon Bedrock · claude-sonnet-5-5 · 1M context · private · api · standard · images · 4 at a time
- guardian-claude-haiku-5-5: Guardian · claude-haiku-5-5 · 1M context · private · org · fast · images · 2 at a time
- claude-code-sonnet: Claude Code · sonnet · 200K context · not private · subscription · standard · runs its own agent in this chat's folder · 2 at a time
- primary: this chat's own model (Qwen3.8 on Spark A) · used when the others are busy
Servers that aren't private must not receive sensitive data. Describe their tasks in general terms — no names, credentials, personal or client details; the app also masks what it detects. A task that needs sensitive data gets sensitive: true, so it runs only on a private server. How busy each server is comes back with every agent and delegate result, and from agent_status.

loads.expect: Subagent servers now: dgx-spark 1/2 busy · bedrock 0/4 busy · guardian-claude-haiku-5-5 0/2 busy · claude-code-sonnet 0/2 busy, not answering (back in 45s) · primary 0/4 busy.
Subagent servers now: dgx-spark 2/2 busy · bedrock 3/4 busy · guardian-claude-haiku-5-5 0/2 busy · claude-code-sonnet 0/2 busy · primary 1/4 busy.
